usedFor: EasyBroker receives property enquiries, and TRIGGERcmd runs “Trigger Command” on your computers when “New Contact Request” arrives.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Request” in Easybroker, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new enquiry can start a command you have set up locally, without anyone watching the inbox.

watchOut: “New Contact Request” in EasyBroker is polling, so “Trigger Command” starts after a scheduled check.
